token = login_resp['access_token']

# fetch release years for each song
song_meta = {}
for sid in unique_song_ids:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    rd = s.get('release_date')
    year = None
    if isinstance(rd, str) and len(rd)>=4 and rd[:4].isdigit():
        year = int(rd[:4])
    song_meta[sid] = {
        'song_id': sid,
        'title': s.get('title'),
        'release_date': rd,
        'year': year,
    }
print('meta_sample', [song_meta[sid] for sid in unique_song_ids[:5]])
# determine candidates released before 2021
candidates_before_2021 = [sid for sid, m in song_meta.items() if m['year'] is not None and m['year'] < 2021]
print('songs_before_2021_count', len(candidates_before_2021))
print('songs_before_2021_ids', sorted(candidates_before_2021))
# determine which are in library
library_set = set(library_song_ids)
playlist_presence = {pid: set(sids) for pid,sids in playlist_song_ids_by_playlist.items()}
# build mapping playlist->songs_to_remove
songs_to_remove_from_library = [sid for sid in candidates_before_2021 if sid in library_set]
playlist_songs_to_remove = {}
for pid, sids in playlist_presence.items():
    to_remove = sorted([sid for sid in sids if sid in candidates_before_2021])
    if to_remove:
        playlist_songs_to_remove[pid] = to_remove
print('library_songs_to_remove_count', len(songs_to_remove_from_library))

relevant_playlist_ids = list(playlist_songs_to_remove.keys())
for pid in relevant_playlist_ids:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=token)

    removed_expected = playlist_songs_to_remove[pid]
    still_present = sorted(set(current_song_ids) & set(removed_expected))
    print(f'playlist {pid} {pl.get("title")} removed_expected={removed_expected} still_present={still_present}')
